How to Apply

For consideration of this position, applicants must submit the following materials as one document: 1) cover letter describing their interest in working in the global social epidemiology of cognitive aging and dementia, 2) their experience working with cross-nationally harmonized longitudinal studies of aging, and 3) a current CV.

Job Summary

The Department of Epidemiology is seeking a Postdoctoral Research Fellow to contribute to research on the global social epidemiology of cognitive aging and dementia. Primary responsibilities include the design and conduct of data analysis in cross-nationally harmonized longitudinal studies of aging in the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol (HCAP) Networks, with emphasis on the Longitudinal Study of Aging in India - Diagnostic Assessment of Dementia (LASI-DAD), preparation of scientific manuscripts and presentations as lead and co-author.
